intents.name: Greeting
intents.description: User greets the chatbot with phrases like Hi, Hello, Hey, Good morning

intents.name: Introduction
intents.description: User introduces themselves (e.g. Hi, my name is Sahil)

intents.name: Provide Name
intents.description: User provides their personal full name

intents.name: Provide Occupation
intents.description: User provides their job title, profession, or work department

intents.name: Provide Phone
intents.description: User provides a contact phone number

intents.name: Provide Location
intents.description: User provides current city, state or country

intents.name: Provide Education
intents.description: User provides degree, university, graduation year or grades

intents.name: Provide Experience
intents.description: User provides job role, company, years, or declares fresher status

intents.name: Provide Skills
intents.description: User lists their technical or professional skills

intents.name: Provide Summary
intents.description: User provides their professional summary paragraph

intents.name: Request Help / Guidance
intents.description: User is uncertain what to write or asks for examples/guidance

intents.name: Skip Question
intents.description: User requests to skip the current question

intents.name: Edit / Correction
intents.description: User corrects a previously submitted value (e.g. Actually my name is Rahul, not Sahil)

intents.name: Confirmation
intents.description: User agrees or confirms (e.g. Yes, exactly, correct, sure)

intents.name: Rejection
intents.description: User disagrees or declines (e.g. No, nope, don't add that)

intents.name: Clarification Needed
intents.description: Input is vague (e.g. 'I am just a normal employee')

intents.name: Unknown
intents.description: Input does not match a clear pattern
